MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
